description: Clients that consume structuredContent should explicitly request format=json and textMode=summary for the versioned complete compact source graph (96KiB body cap); only the duplicate text is replaced by a notice. Text-only clients must use compatible text. Omit format or use format=full for the previous full shape (2MiB cap). Compact overflow is held whole and offers a manual fresh-read full retry if your client accepts the larger response. No material is truncated. The complaint desk's deterministic assessment for a frozen account, a closure notice, a document request, a stuck payment or a refused application: what to do now, the escalation ladder of the bank's jurisdiction (bank complaint, ombudsman or regulator, data access request) with each rung judged for this client — open now, after the bank replies, conditional or not open to them — and linked to its primary source, plus deadlines, cautions and the help that fits. Also returns the letters to send — the formal complaint and the data access request, in English with bracketed placeholders the person fills in themselves. The reported stage is an unverified intake fact; it does not establish completed steps or eligibility. No personal dates are calculated. calendarStatus explains the missing inputs. UK/EU complaint-response rules are returned separately as statutoryReply; the intake does not establish their applicable branch or a statutory due date. Pass holder whenever it is known: an ombudsman's door depends on whose account it is. Information, not legal advice. Never submit a person's contact details; hand them the complaint URL instead.

format.description: Optional. Strongly recommended for agents: json selects wiki-bank-case-compact/1, preserving all native material except derived Markdown in a full-source graph, up to96KiB whole body. Omitted/full retains the previous full DTO including Markdown and compatible text, up to2MiB. No automatic protocol-based format selection.

holder.description: Whose account it is. Optional; without it eligibility is stated, not decided.

jurisdiction.description: Where the bank or the neobank's licence sits.

sanctions.description: Russia or Belarus nexus of the client.

textMode.description: Optional; omitted means compatible, serializing the same complete selected material in TextContent. summary requires explicit format=json and a client that consumes structuredContent; the text is only a transport notice.

today.description: Optional reference date (YYYY-MM-DD), retained for compatibility. It does not establish receipt of a complaint, the applicable procedure, eligibility or a personal due date.

name: assess_bank_case

provenance.description: Origin of one record: stable id, clean canonical URL, publisher, the exact published revision served, a ready citation, primary sources and review status.

id.description: <locale>:<slug> for an article, <dataset>:<record id> for a dataset row.

version.description: Revision of exactly the material served: for an article the snapshot content hash (the HTML ETag value); for a dataset record the dataset revision it was published in, not the published filename. Null when unknown.

reportedStage.description: Stage reported by the caller, not a verified procedural event or eligibility finding.

statutoryReply.description: UK/EU whole native complaint-reply cell with all conditions, caveats and quotations. Personal scope and statutory due date remain unknown. Null outside this cohort.

payload.description: Original native material except derived nativeContextMarkdown. Only object occurrences in sources arrays become { $wikiBankSource: id }. Resolve complete source objects from sourcesById before inspecting citations or verifying native owner byte hashes. Preserve order and repeated occurrences.

sourcesById.description: Complete source objects keyed by canonical full-object SHA plus exact JSON wire SHA. Qualifications, translations, locators, unknown fields and property order participate in identity.

title: Assess a problem with a bank
